errors_found.issue: The interstitial revenue lift (x1.6, :31 and :37) is applied to install-day players, but the code almost never shows them one. maybeInterstitialThen skips games 1-2 (GameViewModel.kt:1234), the countdown starts at 2 (:277), and both call sites (:844 going home, :1208 play again) pass through it. The first interstitial therefore comes in a player's 4th-5th game, and only 98 of 378 first-openers (26%) finished even one game (baseline :127, :138).
errors_found.impact: Limiting the lift to returning players cuts S4 week revenue from Rs2,721 to Rs2,005 (-26%) and S5 from Rs5,920 to Rs4,296 (-27%), AdMob basis. The best in-week return on spend falls from 14.8% to 11.0%, and the model minimum for Rs10k rises from Rs1.25 lakh to Rs1.76 lakh.

errors_found.issue: Day 1 does not match recent days. At today's Rs700 the model gives 78.5 first opens and 110.5 DAU. The same Rs700/day actually delivered 61.8 first opens and 88.5 DAU a day on 18-21 Nov (70.0 first opens on 18-20 Nov; baseline :29-32). errors_found.issue: The 30-day model (growth-model.js:24) has no cost scaling: Rs25/8/4 at any budget. The week-1 model adds +15% per budget doubling (bb_week1_model.js:16-18). growth-model.js:21 also uses a vc40 revenue lift of x1.6 from Day 6, against x1.3 in week-1 (:31). errors_found.issue: GA4 and AdMob revenue are mixed. (a) 'AdMob est.' multiplies total revenue, purchases included, by 1.15 (:38 + :59). (b) The 1.15 is month-to-date ($4.50 vs $3.93). errors_found.issue: The retention curve is applied to the wrong reference. R0 (D1 15%) was measured on cohorts that were about 47% Cross-network (T3), and then T3 gets x0.6 on top (:10, :12), giving 9% D1. The 19 Nov cohort was 43 of 49 Cross-network yet returned 18% on day 1. That puts T3 D1 at least 7% even if every other user returned, and about 17% if the others returned at 25%; 18 Nov implies about 13%. Separately, the 14.6% headline (baseline :180, roadmap :85) leaves out 32 installs from cohorts with zero returns: it is 13.2% over all 334 (13.9% excluding the partial 20 Nov cohort).

errors_found.issue: The one-day delivery lag is coded correctly (:24-25: today's Rs700 is locked, a change delivers tomorrow). summary:
I rebuilt the week-1 model independently. A replica reproduces every number the original prints (S0-S5), and a second, parameterised simulator matches it before applying fixes. The weekly totals are arithmetically right, but the model has real errors:
- **Revenue column bug.** The 'revenue Day 7' column and S2's daily table are cumulative (bb_week1_model.js:43). S2's Saturday is Rs161/day, not Rs651.
- **Scenarios are not minimums.** S1-S3 overspend 1.4-5.6x against the true minimum for their labelled targets, and S2 actually misses the weekly average (498).
- **Interstitial lift is overstated.** The x1.6 is applied to install-day players, who the code never shows an interstitial before their 4th-5th game (GameViewModel.kt:277, :1234). S4/S5 revenue is about 26% too high.
- **Costs are too cheap.** Day 1 gives 78.5 first opens and 110.5 DAU against 61.8 and 88.5 actually delivered on 18-21 Nov, so CPIs are 13-30% low.
- **The 30-day model has no cost scaling.** With week-1's own rule, path C reaches 741 installs/day on Day 30, not 1,106, so the roadmap claim that path C hits all three targets fails.
- **Smaller issues:** the GA4/AdMob mix-up, T3 retention double-penalised, the D1 headline leaving out zero-return cohorts, and an aggressive vc40 schedule.

Minimum spend for the week, including today's locked Rs700:
- **1,000 downloads in the week:** YES. Rs4.95k, or Rs7.3k keeping today's T1 (Rs2.7k-5.3k counted as Play installs).
- **1,000 per day every day Sun-Sat:** NO. Sunday is locked at about 79 first opens.
- **1,000 per day Mon-Sat:** CONDITIONAL. Rs40.6k-43k with a new India campaign at about Rs6.5k/day from Monday.
- **1,000 on Saturday only:** CONDITIONAL. Rs7.3k-11.2k as a one-day burst.
- **500 DAU weekly average Sun-Sat:** CONDITIONAL. Rs16.5k-19k (Mon-Sat average Rs14.3k).
- **500 DAU every day Mon-Sat:** CONDITIONAL. Rs14.5k-19k, and it fails on Monday if the new campaign under-delivers.
- **500 DAU on Saturday:** YES. Rs3.4k (Saturday India burst only), Rs7.1k keeping today's budget.
- **Rs10k revenue:** NO. The model minimum is Rs1.25 lakh as written (Rs1.76 lakh with the code-guard fix), and Monday's T1 budget would have to be 71x today's. The in-week return ceiling of 14.8% sets a hard floor of Rs65.9k. If budgets rise at most 20% a day, as Google advises, the week tops out at about Rs1.3k; doubling budgets daily (Rs84k) reaches about Rs6k.

No single sensitivity flips a verdict (CPI x0.7/x1.5, D1 10%/25%, revenue x0.5/x2, interstitials on or never, AdMob 1.6x, vc40 slip, T3 quality, compounding CPI). CPI moves the download and DAU spends by -33%/+58%. Two things do flip results: Monday under-delivery breaks the 'every day from Monday' readings, and the four-factor optimistic corner brings Rs10k down to Rs19.7k of spend (still only Rs5.6k if budgets rise at most 20% a day).
